propositions: The completion verifier pins a stale local ticket store mirror instead of the live tracker HEAD, causing the model to read ticket state that is arbitrarily many commits behind (measured: 6757 commits) the actual store.

The gate's fenced context provided to the model comes from the live store, while the model's show_ticket reads the pinned snapshot; the prompt designates show_ticket as authoritative, causing the model to prefer stale data.

A non-PASS verdict with empty findings is coerced to FAIL and synthesizes a fabricated criterion (unspecified) instead of reporting inability to obtain a verdict, leaving no remediation path for operators.

The fetch=False flag in close_precheck threads through to materialize_tickets, skipping origin/tickets sync for the ticket store and pinning only the local mirror, whereas fetch=True is intended to allow network access.

Two independent tickets (wailsome-unsure-asianlion, fixable-angular-caribou) were blocked by stale snapshots presenting as false "record does not exist" and "evidence collection boundary" symptoms that resolve to PASS after reading current store state.
